name: f4-reference-profiles
description: Annotates the three reference bases F4_CURV_DEPTH_KPI_ORIG_CHARACTERISTICS already freezes (GDX_HNF_CDI_REFERENCE_SET/GDX_HNF_CDI_REFERENCE_VALUE) with structured stratification (GDX_HNF_REFPROF_STRATUM) and norm-source provenance (GDX_HNF_REFPROF_NORM_SOURCE), and pairs one PERSONAL_BASELINE-scored GDX_HNF_CDI_RUN with one STUDY_COHORT/POPULATION_REFERENCE-scored GDX_HNF_CDI_RUN evaluated against the same GDX_HNF_FEATURE_SPACE_RUN, freezing CDIpersonal and CDIpopulation side by side (GDX_HNF_REFPROF_DUAL_RUN/GDX_HNF_REFPROF_DUAL_VALUE) without ever fusing them. Never computes CDIx or a reference center itself -- that stays F4_CURV_DEPTH_KPI_ORIG_CHARACTERISTICS's own job.
